id: 19_Stay Safe In The Lab Mastering Emergency Response For Biological Incidents
title: 生物安全事故的应急处置（国内版）
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/19_Stay Safe In The Lab Mastering Emergency Response For Biological Incidents.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/19_Stay Safe In The Lab Mastering Emergency Response For Biological Incidents（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 生物暴露，必须马上行动
points.K5: 清理不偷工，消毒要彻底
points.K11: 规定不是建议，必须照做

shots.scene: 欣欣站在贴有生物危害标志的实验室门外，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands outside a lab door marked with a biohazard warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲生物安全事故的应急处置。
overlay: 生物安全事故的应急处置

shots.scene: 控制、消毒、冲洗、报告、处置五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a barrier tape, a spray bottle, a water tap, a telephone and a sharps box. No people.
shots.narration: 控制、消毒、冲洗、报告、处置。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜旁处理血液样本，阿杰在一旁收拾注射器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with blood sample tubes at a biological safety cabinet while the young male student tidies used syringes on the bench.
shots.narration: 小研在处理血液样本，阿杰在收拾注射器。

shots.scene: 阿杰手指一缩，表情吃痛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flinches and pulls back his finger with a pained look; a small syringe icon floats nearby.
shots.narration: 一不小心，阿杰被用过的针头扎了一下。

shots.scene: 小研立刻放下手中的活，拉着阿杰走向水槽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student immediately stops her work and leads the young male student to the lab sink.
shots.narration: 小研说：别慌，马上处理！

shots.section_title: 生物暴露，必须马上行动
shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地站在生物危害标志旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biohazard warning sign with a serious face.
shots.narration: 病原体和生物毒素，出事升级很快。
overlay: 生物暴露，必须马上行动

shots.section_title: 生物暴露，必须马上行动
shots.scene: 秒表图标飞快转动
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon with its hand spinning fast. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦暴露，没有时间犹豫。

shots.scene: 台面上一摊洒出的样本，周围画出红圈
shots.prompt_en: A small spill of sample liquid on a lab bench with a red circle drawn around it. No people.
shots.narration: 发生溢洒，第一步是控制。

shots.scene: 门口拉起警示带，立起生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: Warning tape is stretched across a lab doorway with a biohazard warning sign on a stand. No people.
shots.narration: 拉起警示带，挂上生物危害标志。

shots.scene: 无关人员图标沿箭头离开房间
shots.prompt_en: Person pictograms leave the room along an arrow toward the door. No people.
shots.narration: 无关的人，先离开。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜内操作，气溶胶小点被吸进柜内
shots.prompt_en: Inside a biological safety cabinet, tiny aerosol dots are drawn back into the cabinet by airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 易产生气溶胶的操作，放在安全柜里做。

shots.scene: 红圈把危害关在里面，向外的箭头被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A red circle around a spill with outward arrows blocked at the edge by a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 目标很简单：关住它，不让它扩散。

shots.section_title: 清理不偷工，消毒要彻底
shots.scene: 小研穿戴好防护，用喷壶给安全柜台面消毒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a lab coat, goggles, mask and gloves, sprays disinfectant on the work surface of a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 清理时，不能偷工减料。
overlay: 清理不偷工，消毒要彻底

shots.section_title: 清理不偷工，消毒要彻底
shots.scene: 空白标签的消毒剂瓶和病原图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle with a blank label next to a germ icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 选对消毒剂，彻底消灭病原。

shots.scene: 小研把污染器材装入灭菌袋放进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student loads a bag of contaminated tools into an autoclave.
shots.narration: 污染的器材，送去高压灭菌。

shots.scene: 灭菌器门关上，指示灯亮起绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The autoclave door closes and an indicator lamp turns green with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 灭菌到位，不能半途而废。

shots.scene: 注射器针头图标旁出现血滴和警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A used syringe needle icon with a drop of blood and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 被可能带血的针头扎伤，

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指，神情严肃
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger with an urgent look.
shots.narration: 立即处理，是最关键的一步。

shots.scene: 阿杰在水槽边用肥皂和流水冲洗手指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his finger with soap under running water at the lab sink.
shots.narration: 马上用肥皂和流水冲洗。

shots.scene: 小研陪阿杰走到挂红十字的医院门口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks the young male student to the entrance of a clinic building with a red cross sign.
shots.narration: 然后尽快就医。

shots.scene: 空白事故记录表和笔
shots.prompt_en: A blank incident record form with a pen. No people.
shots.narration: 把经过记下来：时间、样本、怎么扎的。

shots.scene: 诊室桌上放着空白处方单和药盒
shots.prompt_en: A blank prescription slip and a plain medicine box on a clinic desk, with a red cross icon. No people.
shots.narration: 医生评估需要预防用药，就及时用。

shots.scene: 拖延的时钟图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a clock with a waiting person beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要拖，也不要自己判断没事。

shots.section_title: 规定不是建议，必须照做
shots.scene: 空白法规文件和生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A blank regulation binder next to a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 处理生物危害，有明确规定。
overlay: 规定不是建议，必须照做

shots.section_title: 规定不是建议，必须照做
shots.scene: 从控制到处置的流程箭头
shots.prompt_en: A process arrow linking icons from a barrier tape to a disinfectant bottle to a waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 从控制到处置，每一步都要照做。

shots.scene: 用过的针头直接丢进锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: A used syringe is dropped straight into a rigid yellow sharps box. No people.
shots.narration: 污染物要正确处置，针头进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 敞口托盘里堆满针头的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open tray piled with used needles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能随手放在敞口盘子里。

shots.scene: 王老师和小研一起核对空白操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the female graduate student review a blank operating procedure together.
shots.narration: 按规范来，才能保护每一个人。

shots.scene: 小研穿戴防护后，用吸水纸盖住溢洒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing lab coat, goggles, mask and double gloves, covers a spill with absorbent paper towels.
shots.narration: 小量溢洒：先用吸水纸盖住。

shots.scene: 消毒剂从外圈向中心倒在纸上
shots.prompt_en: Disinfectant is poured onto the paper towels from the outer edge toward the center, shown by spiral arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 从外向内倒上消毒剂。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon beside the covered spill. No people.
shots.narration: 作用足够时间。

shots.scene: 用镊子夹起纸巾放入生物危害废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Tongs lift the soaked paper towels into a biohazard waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 再清理，废物按感染性废物处置。

shots.scene: 安全柜外一瓶培养物摔碎，雾点飘起
shots.prompt_en: A culture flask breaks on the floor outside the biological safety cabinet and tiny mist dots rise. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜外打碎、可能有气溶胶，

shots.scene: 小研憋气，带着阿杰快步出门关门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds her breath and leads the young male student quickly out, closing the door behind them.
shots.narration: 立即撤离，关上门。

shots.scene: 门上挂生物危害标志，沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed lab door with a biohazard warning sign and an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 挂上警示，静置后再由专人处理。

shots.scene: 手指伤口旁，从手掌向指尖的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A finger with a small wound and a gentle arrow pointing from the palm toward the fingertip. No people.
shots.narration: 针刺伤：从近心端向远心端轻挤。

shots.scene: 直接挤压伤口和用嘴吸的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of squeezing hard right on the wound and sucking the wound, crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不要用力挤压伤口，更不能用嘴吸。

shots.scene: 冲洗后用消毒棉签消毒并贴上创可贴
shots.prompt_en: After rinsing, a cotton swab disinfects the finger and a bandage is applied. No people.
shots.narration: 冲洗后消毒、包扎。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和洗眼器出水
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 溅入眼睛，用洗眼器反复冲洗。

shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边是报告链条图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; beside her are linked icons of a lab, a department building and a biosafety office.
shots.narration: 暴露和溢洒，都要立即报告。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 情况紧急，拨打120。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白记录本上登记，后续随访日历
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes in a blank incident logbook next to a calendar icon for follow-up.
shots.narration: 登记在案，按要求随访。

shots.scene: 用双手回套针帽的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two hands putting a cap back on a used needle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的针头，不回套针帽。

shots.scene: 锐器盒放在操作位旁，伸手可及
shots.prompt_en: A sharps box placed right next to the work area within easy reach. No people.
shots.narration: 锐器盒放在手边，用完直接丢。

shots.scene: 塞得过满的锐器盒被打叉，封口的锐器盒打勾
shots.prompt_en: An overfilled sharps box crossed out with a red X; a properly closed sharps box with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 锐器盒不装太满，到线就封口。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现警示带和消毒剂图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a barrier tape and a disinfectant bottle.
shots.narration: 溢洒：先控制，再消毒清理。

shots.scene: 门和沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed door icon and an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有气溶胶，先撤离。

shots.scene: 水龙头、医院、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a water tap, a hospital and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 针刺暴露：冲洗、就医、报告。

shots.scene: 锐器盒打勾
shots.prompt_en: A closed sharps box with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 针头不回套，直接进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门外挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye outside a lab door with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 沉着应对，守护健康，下次见！
